summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Blog User Management feature. All backend auth gates, legacy login paths, and frontend UI elements verified. All regression tests passed.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/crm/blog-users without Clerk token returns 401
Backend: POST /api/admin/crm/blog-users without Clerk token returns 401
Backend: Legacy /api/admin/login accepts env ADMIN_PASSWORD without username (founder path) - returns 200 with token
Backend: Legacy /api/admin/login rejects wrong credentials with 401
Backend: Login with blank username + env ADMIN_PASSWORD returns 200 with founder token
Backend: Login with username + wrong password returns 401
Frontend: /admin/blog login screen renders with 'Username (optional)' and 'Password' inputs
Frontend: Login with blank username + env ADMIN_PASSWORD successfully signs into /admin/blog dashboard
Frontend: Homepage hero 'Start a Conversation' button visible (opacity > 0.95)
Frontend: Homepage hero 'Schedule a Meeting' button visible (opacity > 0.95)
Frontend: /blog list page shows blog post cards (opacity > 0.95)
